name: A planetarium hall: the player walks down into the pit, up onto the stage and up the raked floor

designStructure.title: Late Show at Calder Planetarium
designStructure.premise: The volunteers of a small-town planetarium rehearse the autumn sky show for a school visit while a storm rattles the dome.
designStructure.opening: Doors open at eight. The projector lamp is new and nobody has tested it yet.

checks.name: The player starts part-way up the raked floor
The player walks down the steps into the projector pit
The player climbs the steps onto the stage
The stage is no higher than authored
A jump on the stage rises above every floor level in the hall
The jump lands back on the stage, not on the storey slab
The player climbs the rake to the rear gallery
The player never leaves the hall's storey
The hall floor keeps its layout invariants
The hall is furnished with composed objects
